# Painless Roofing & Water Restoration

> Family-owned roofing and water damage restoration company in Canton, GA 30115, serving North Georgia. Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Phone: (404) 444-4476. Licensed and insured. Known for honest assessments, clear communication, insurance-claim documentation help, and fast emergency response.

Key facts:
- Location: Canton, Georgia 30115 (Cherokee County)
- Phone: (404) 444-4476 — answered 24/7
- Hours: Open 24 hours, Monday through Sunday
- Family-owned, licensed and insured
- Free online roof assessment with an explainable urgency score
- Insurance claim documentation assistance (no outcome guarantees)

## Services

- [Roof Repair](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/roof-repair): Leak diagnosis and repair, shingle replacement, flashing and ventilation fixes
- [Roof Replacement](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/roof-replacement): Full replacement with quality materials and clear pricing
- [Roof Installation](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/roof-installation): New-construction and addition roofing
- [Metal Roofing](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/metal-roofing): Standing-seam and ribbed metal installation and repair
- [Commercial Roofing](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/commercial-roofing): Low-slope and commercial systems
- [Storm Damage](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/storm-damage): Hail and wind damage documentation and restoration
- [Insurance Claim Assistance](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/insurance-claims): Damage documentation the way adjusters expect
- [Emergency Roofing](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/emergency-roofing): 24/7 tarping and stabilization
- [Water Damage Restoration](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/water-damage-restoration): Fast response to prevent mold and secondary damage
- [Siding](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/siding): Siding repair and replacement
- [Gutters](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/gutters): Seamless gutters and guards
- [Roof Inspection](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/roof-inspection): Professional photo-documented inspections
- [Maintenance Plans](https://painlessroofingandwaterrestoration.com/services/maintenance-plans): Preventive roof care
